objective.en: Describe a place or an event in the past with there was and there were, in statements, negatives and questions.
objective.fr: Décrire un lieu ou un événement passé avec there was et there were, à la forme affirmative, négative et interrogative.
objective.de: Einen Ort oder ein Ereignis in der Vergangenheit mit there was und there were beschreiben, in Aussagen, Verneinungen und Fragen.

instructions.en: Read the explanation and the examples.
instructions.de: Lies die Erklärung und die Beispiele.

text.en:
`there was` and `there were` say that something existed in the past. Use `there was` with one thing or an uncountable noun. Use `there were` with more than one thing.

- `There was a party last night.`
- `There was some music in the park.`
- `There were two beds in the room.`

The present forms are `there is` and `there are`. In the past, they become `there was` and `there were`: look at the noun that follows. Compare `There was a lot of snow.` and `There were a lot of people.`
text.fr:
`there was` et `there were` indiquent que quelque chose existait dans le passé. On emploie `there was` avec un seul élément ou un nom indénombrable, et `there were` avec plusieurs éléments.

- `There was a party last night.`
- `There was some music in the park.`
- `There were two beds in the room.`

Au présent, on dit `there is` et `there are`. Au passé, ils deviennent `there was` et `there were` : regardez le nom qui suit. Comparez `There was a lot of snow.` et `There were a lot of people.`
text.de:
`there was` und `there were` sagen, dass etwas in der Vergangenheit da war. Man benutzt `there was` bei einer Sache oder einem nicht zählbaren Nomen und `there were` bei mehr als einer Sache.

- `There was a party last night.`
- `There was some music in the park.`
- `There were two beds in the room.`

Im Präsens heißt es `there is` und `there are`. In der Vergangenheit werden daraus `there was` und `there were`: Achte auf das Nomen danach. Vergleiche `There was a lot of snow.` und `There were a lot of people.`

instructions.en: Read the explanation and the examples.
instructions.de: Lies die Erklärung und die Beispiele.

text.en:
For a negative, add `n't`: `there wasn't` and `there weren't`. After a negative, use `a` with one thing and `any` with plural or uncountable nouns.

- `There wasn't a lift in the hotel.`
- `There weren't any seats on the train.`
- `There wasn't any milk.`

For a question, put `was` or `were` before `there`, and answer with a short answer.

- `Was there a doctor in the village?` `Yes, there was.`
- `Were there any shops near the hotel?` `No, there weren't.`
text.fr:
Pour la forme négative, ajoutez `n't` : `there wasn't` et `there weren't`. Après une négation, on emploie `a` avec un seul élément et `any` avec un pluriel ou un nom indénombrable.

- `There wasn't a lift in the hotel.`
- `There weren't any seats on the train.`
- `There wasn't any milk.`

Pour une question, placez `was` ou `were` avant `there`, et répondez par une réponse courte.

- `Was there a doctor in the village?` `Yes, there was.`
- `Were there any shops near the hotel?` `No, there weren't.`
text.de:
Für die Verneinung hängst du `n't` an: `there wasn't` und `there weren't`. Nach einer Verneinung steht `a` bei einer Sache und `any` bei Plural oder nicht zählbaren Nomen.

- `There wasn't a lift in the hotel.`
- `There weren't any seats on the train.`
- `There wasn't any milk.`

Für eine Frage stellst du `was` oder `were` vor `there` und antwortest mit einer Kurzantwort.

- `Was there a doctor in the village?` `Yes, there was.`
- `Were there any shops near the hotel?` `No, there weren't.`
